title: Design System: Rafael Sant' Anna Portfolio

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Reveal and state transitions that settle quickly.

motion.name: signal-scan
motion.purpose: A single portrait scan that communicates a live system.

components.name: Operational Status Rail
components.description: A cyan status line that communicates role, focus, location, and availability.

components.name: Signal Portrait
components.description: Rafael's real portrait integrated with a grid, cyan scan, live status, and expertise labels.

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Large alternating project evidence with real media and operational context.

narrative.overview: A cinematic operations room using deep navy, cyan signals, electric-blue fields, ice contrast, and Rafael's real portrait.
keyCharacteristics: The portrait creates a strong personal focal point without imitating terminal aesthetics.
Cyan communicates live state and actions; electric blue carries brand depth.
Light evidence fields interrupt the dark room and keep long-form work legible.
Motion is progressive enhancement and reduced-motion safe.

rules.name: The Electric Field Rule
rules.body: Electric blue must carry the identity across major moments.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks an action, live status, or turning point.

rules.name: The One Display Move Rule
rules.body: A screen may have one dominant typographic gesture.

donts: Do not copy Ruben Marcus's green terminal or portrait treatment.
Do not publish fictional projects or inflated metrics.
